task_title: Queue-age, deferral, catalogue and DB-growth gauges on /metrics/prom (cached, not per-scrape)
task_criteria: /metrics/prom exposes obo_queue_oldest_pending_age_seconds, obo_queue_deferred_total{reason}, obo_catalog_verified_answers, obo_catalog_hit_rate, obo_discovery_requests_total{outcome}, obo_db_size_bytes{kind}; oldest_pending_age matches SQL within 60s; verified_answers matches /api/v1/stats; db_size main matches stat -c %s; scrape latency < 50ms; gauges come from a cached sampler (no SQL in the scrape handler). REJECTS: editing README.md or pkg/api/openapi.yaml.

items.criterion: /metrics/prom exposes obo_queue_oldest_pending_age_seconds, obo_queue_deferred_total{reason}, obo_catalog_verified_answers, obo_catalog_hit_rate, obo_discovery_requests_total{outcome}, obo_db_size_bytes{kind}; oldest_pending_age matches SQL within 60s; verified_answers matches /api/v1/stats; db_size main matches stat -c %s; scrape latency < 50ms; gauges come from a cached sampler (no SQL in the scrape handler). REJECTS: editing README.md or pkg/api/openapi.yaml.
items.detail: Live proof on a scratch instance (binary built from HEAD, /tmp/ob1 -db /tmp/ob1test/t.db -port 18766, seeded 3235 classes/4869 answers). `curl -s :18766/metrics/prom` returned all six families: `obo_queue_oldest_pending_age_seconds 753.76098901`, `obo_queue_deferred_total{reason="load"} 34` / `{reason="load+memory"} 0` / `{reason="memory"} 0`, `obo_catalog_verified_answers 4869`, `obo_catalog_hit_rate 1`, `obo_discovery_requests_total{outcome="hit"} 0` / `{outcome="miss"} 0`, `obo_db_size_bytes{kind="main"} 4.9033216e+07` / `{kind="wal"} 374952`. Agreement: SQL `SELECT (julianday('now')-julianday(MIN(created_at)))*86400 ... status IN ('pending','deferred','in_progress')` = 768.73 vs gauge 753.76 (15s cache lag, well inside 60s); /api/v1/stats `verified_answers 4869, hit_rate 1` == gauge 4869/1; `stat -c %s t.db` = 49033216 == 4.9033216e+07. Latency: `curl -w %{time_total}` on /metrics/prom = 0.000555/0.000852/0.000593 s (<50ms) while /api/v1/stats took 0.0288 s. Counters move live: after 3 discover calls hit=1/miss=2; after 5 gated ticks with a pending head deferred{reason="load"}=5. No SQL in the scrape: internal/metrics/prom_db.go:180-231 dbGaugeCollector.Collect only copies dbGaugeCache.snapshot(); PromConfig.DBDerived is called solely from RefreshDB (prom_db.go:126-140), driven by StartDBRefresh from cmd/off-by-one/main.go:331-332. REJECTS honoured: `git diff --name-only fecbac11 78b47e1c | grep -E 'README.md|pkg/api/openapi.yaml'` → no output; commit fe3be63e touches only cmd/ and internal/. Gates: `go build ./...` exit 0, `go vet ./...` exit 0, `gofmt -l cmd/ internal/ pkg/ sql/` empty, `go test ./... -short -count=1 -p 1 -timeout 300s` → every package `ok` (internal/metrics 0.489s, internal/api 1.207s, internal/ingest 0.248s, internal/cron 0.137s), including TestPromDBGaugesCachedNotQueriedPerScrape and TestMetricsPromTier3AgreesWithStats. [resolution 0.17; README.md]

items.criterion: The six families are reachable from the production entrypoint (cmd/off-by-one/main.go wiring + GET /metrics/prom route), not only from unit tests.
items.detail: cmd/off-by-one/main.go:249-320 builds metrics.NewProm with DBDerived (queue.Depth, queue.OldestPendingAge, store.Stats, os.Stat(*cfg.dbPath) and dbPath+"-wal"), Discovery (observer.DiscoveryCounts) and Deferrals (observer.Deferrals); main.go:320 `apiServer.Prom = prom`; route registered at internal/api/server.go:185 `mux.HandleFunc("GET /metrics/prom", s.handleMetricsProm)` → server.go:397-399. Confirmed end-to-end by the live curl above, not just by unit tests.

items.criterion: The DB-derived readings are refreshed on a ticker (StartDBRefresh) and the refresher is stopped on shutdown so it cannot race store.Close().
items.detail: cmd/off-by-one/main.go:331-332 `promCtx, promCancel := context.WithCancel(...)` + `prom.StartDBRefresh(promCtx, metrics.DefaultDBRefreshInterval)` (15s, prom_db.go:31); main.go:412 `promCancel()` runs in the SIGINT/SIGTERM handler before srv.Shutdown and before the deferred store.Close() (main.go:436 wg.Wait). internal/metrics/prom_db.go:143-166 refreshes once synchronously then on a ticker, returning on ctx.Done. `go test ./internal/metrics -run TestPromDBRefreshTicker -v` → `--- PASS: TestPromDBRefreshTicker (0.17s)` (asserts refresh on interval and no calls after cancel).

items.criterion: The change does not edit README.md or pkg/api/openapi.yaml (task REJECTS clause).
items.detail: `git diff --name-only fecbac11 78b47e1c | grep -E 'README.md|pkg/api/openapi.yaml'` produced no output (exit 1). `git show fe3be63e --stat` lists only cmd/off-by-one/main.go, internal/api/{server.go,metrics_prom_test.go}, internal/cron/{loop.go,loop_test.go}, internal/ingest/{queue.go,queue_test.go}, internal/metrics/{metrics.go,prom.go,prom_db.go,prom_db_test.go,prom_test.go}. README.md (ae5c0280, 19:15) and pkg/api/openapi.yaml (ab6613b6, 19:28) were edited by separate sibling tasks (README-9, REVIEW-OB-024) before fe3be63e (19:45) and are not part of this task's change.

items.criterion: A failed/unreadable leg is omitted rather than fabricated as 0, and the closed label vocabularies are always emitted.
items.detail: internal/metrics/prom_db.go:180-231 gates each leg on its own OK flag (OldestPendingOK, CatalogOK, DBSizeMainOK, DBSizeWALOK) and skips the series when false; deferredTotalCollector iterates SkipReasons (prom.go:397) and discoveryTotalCollector iterates DiscoveryOutcomes (prom.go:426), so every label is present at 0 before it fires. `go test ./internal/metrics -run 'TestDB|TestProm' -v` → PASS for TestPromDBUnreadLegsAreOmitted, TestPromTier3NilSource, TestPromDBEmptyQueueAgeIsZero, TestPromTier3ClosedVocabulary.

items.criterion: The new SQL (queue.OldestPendingAge) uses the same status set as queue.Depth /api/v1/stats and clamps clock skew, so the gauge cannot disagree with the JSON surface.
items.detail: internal/ingest/queue.go:667-684 uses `status IN ('pending','deferred','in_progress')` — identical to Depth (queue.go:645-652) which handleStats serves (internal/api/handlers.go:861-866) — computes the age in SQL against julianday('now') (UTC, matching created_at's datetime('now')), and returns 0 for a non-positive age. `go test ./internal/ingest -run TestQueue_OldestPendingAge -v` PASSes and asserts the age covers exactly the statuses Depth counts (Depth==3, complete row excluded). Live: SQL 768.73 vs gauge 753.76.
